_: Navmesh PATHING test (follow-up to the 2026-06-03 navmesh breakthrough). Builds the custom worldspace MFTestWorld (flat LAND + a 4096x4096 navmesh quad at z=4000, NAVI as an additive override of Skyrim.esm:0x00012FB4) AND drops a guard who patrols three markers laid out ON that navmesh. If the navmesh truly works, the guard paces the triangle m1->m2->m3->m1; if not, he stands still. Test: `cow MFTestWorld 0 0`, wait ~30-90s for the patrol package cold-start, watch the guard. esl=false is mandatory (worldspaces carry LAND, which ESL plugins can't hold). The markers sit at z=4000 = exactly the flat navmesh height (static XMarkerHeadings don't snap to the floor, so they must be authored at the mesh height — see examples/patrol_spec.json for that lesson).

packages._: Patrol template (Skyrim.esm:0x017723). start -> m1; the route is the markers' linkedRef chain m1->m2->m3->m1 (looped). Walk pace, repeatable, startAtNearest.

placements._: The guard, spawned at the centre of the navmesh quad. z=4000 = the flat navmesh/terrain height. startAtNearest=true → begins from whichever marker is closest.
Marker 1 (route start). All three markers sit at z=4000 inside the 0..4096 navmesh quad, ≥1024 units from the edges. linkedRef -> m2. Auto-persistent (linked-ref source + patrol start anchor).
